A warrior ventured too deep into the earth. Go down the small cave east of {wiki:Mount Sternum}, near the {wiki:Triangle Tower}, open holes with the pick and cross rooms full of {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} to a cave surrounded by lava, where the {item:Spike Sword} is inside a body hidden behind a pillar.
A warrior travelled too deep into the earth.
Small cave east of Mount Sternum
{spell:Invisible} spell or {item:Stealth Ring|Stealth Rings}, because of the Fire Devils
The {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} attack with fireballs from a distance. Become invisible ({spell:Invisible} or {item:Stealth Ring}) from the 3rd floor on.
Bring health potions: in the last room many Fire Devils can hit you from the lava islands.
1. Go down to the Fire Devils

The cave is between Thais and Kazordoon: **east** of {wiki:Mount Sternum} (which is northeast of Thais) and **northeast** of the {wiki:Triangle Tower}. Walk from **Thais** (to the northeast) or from **Kazordoon** (to the south) to the entrance coordinates.
Go to the small cave **east of {wiki:Mount Sternum}** and go down.
You are in a small room. Go down one more floor, as on the map.
Open the southwest hole with a pick
In this room, use the {item:Pick} to open a hole right to the **southwest**, as the map shows. Go down through it.
2nd floor: where to pick the hole
Go around to the west and go down

In this room there is a {creature:Fire Devil}. Follow the passage that curves around to the **west** and go down one more floor. This is a good time to use {spell:Invisible} or the {item:Stealth Ring}.
3rd floor: the passage to the west
Open the hole in the southwest corner with a pick
On this floor there are **5 {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}**. Go to the **southwest** corner of the room, open another hole with the {item:Pick} and go down.
4th floor: the hole in the southwest corner

You are surrounded by lava and many {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}: **4** can be reached and **10** are on islands, but they still hit you with fireballs. The recommendation is for someone to become {spell:Invisible} and clear the room.
The lava cave and the pillar with the body
The Fire Devils on the islands cannot be reached in melee but they hit you from a distance.
The reward is inside a **body hidden behind a pillar** (see map). Open it and take the {item:Spike Sword}.

To leave, go back the same way: use the {item:Rope} at the two holes you opened with the {item:Pick} (the one in the lava cave and the one on the floor with the 5 Fire Devils) and, on the other floors, climb up at the same spots where you went down to the cave entrance, east of Mount Sternum. Stay {spell:Invisible} or keep the {item:Stealth Ring} on while you pass the Fire Devils.
You will probably hear the roar of three {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. They are caged at the far north of the room; nobody knows how or why they are there.
